name: Community Thanksgiving Potluck Dinner
location: Federated Church of Wauconda, Wauconda IL 60084
cost: Free (bring a dish or dessert to share)
raw: Community Thanksgiving Potluck Dinner, Saturday November 21 2026, 6:00 PM-7:00 PM, Federated Church of Wauconda. You and your family are invited to a Thanksgiving potluck dinner. Bring a dish to pass or a dessert to share. Collecting donations for PADS Lake County. Please sign up in the church foyer by November 19 or use the sign-up link.
notes: Potluck: bring a dish or dessert to share. Sign up by Nov 19 (church foyer or online link on the church's events page). Also collecting donations for PADS Lake County.

name: Free Community Thanksgiving Dinner at Big Ed's BBQ
location: Big Ed's BBQ, 651 Lakehurst Rd, Waukegan IL 60085
raw: Big Ed's BBQ will be providing a FREE Thanksgiving meal for the community on Thanksgiving day. Meals will be provided from 12-4pm. 651 Lakehurst Rd, Waukegan. 6th Annual Free Community Thanksgiving Dinner to anyone in need. (Big Ed's BBQ Facebook and Instagram posts, Oct 2026)
notes: 6th annual free community Thanksgiving dinner, Thanksgiving Day, 12-4 PM, for anyone in need. From the restaurant's own Facebook/Instagram posts (no event page); in past years it was a limited number of meals per car, so call the restaurant to confirm.
